author: PokerFace
body:
Hello, Bloodoh, Tomqss, and I have made another map along with a few other friends. Any feedback is appreciated before we retrieve a download. There is one gapple spawner in the middle and 2 arrow spawners to the left and right of it. We understand that TDM in a void map may seem kind of weird, but please keep your mind open to this!

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/dLQ8g
YML: Will ask mapdev.
DL: Pending.
